pipeline_protection_page.desc_p1: At crossings of operating main gas pipelines across category 3-5 motor roads, when protective casings must be installed without halting gas transmission, a split pipe casing design (composed of two halves) can be utilized.
pipeline_protection_page.desc_p2: Such a necessity may arise during major repairs of gas pipelines or road reconstruction.
